title: Nothing short of amazing
quote:
Good Doggos in San Jacinto has been nothing short of amazing for me and my two dogs Bella (pug) & Khamila (Boxer). Victor is exceptionally professional, and he truly has a special bond with dogs — he's genuinely gifted at what he does. I would highly recommend him to anyone with a reactive dog like mine.

Before working with Victor, my boxer Khamila was extremely reactive toward other dogs. She would lunge, bark, and on multiple occasions even dragged me through the grass during walks. I had previously hired another trainer before finding Good Doggos, and I was told things like, "Some dogs just aren't meant to meet other dogs," and "She just has a strong personality." Eventually, I gave up hope that things would improve.

Walks became something I dreaded because I was constantly afraid Khamila would hurt another dog. Bella would also feed off her energy, so trying to control both of them at once became overwhelming.

Then I met Victor. From the beginning, he reassured me that he could help — and he absolutely did. On the very first day, Khamila was introduced to another dog and did completely fine. Victor has his own helper dogs (Simba, Chico, & Rocky) that specifically work with reactive dogs like mine, and they were incredibly calm, well-behaved, and professional throughout the process. Watching how confidently and carefully his dogs interacted with mine immediately put me at ease and gave me hope that things really could improve. Since then, my fears have been put at ease. She is so much calmer now, and our relationship has become much stronger. She listens to me, and she truly feels like a completely different dog in the best possible way.

I would recommend Good Doggos to anyone who is willing to put in the effort for their dog. Victor gives you the tools, resources, and knowledge you need, but as a responsible pet owner, you also have to put in the work. Once you do, the results are absolutely worth it. Your dog will be happier, and so will you.
